css.title: CSS Foundations
css.description: A practical beginner CSS course covering the cascade, selectors, typography, the box model, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, reusable CSS, accessible states, and a complete multi-page responsive capstone.
css.moreComingSoon: More CSS Foundations lessons are coming soon.

css-module-1-first-styles.title: First Styles and the Cascade
css-module-1-first-styles.description: Build confidence with first CSS rules and understand why the browser applies one style instead of another.
outcomes: Compare inline, internal, and external CSS, then use external stylesheets for reusable presentation.
Write clear selectors and declaration blocks.
Use color and typography to create visual hierarchy.
Reason about the cascade, inheritance, and specificity.
why: Builds confidence with first styles and the cascade.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-module-2-box-model-spacing.title: The Box Model and Spacing
css-module-2-box-model-spacing.description: Make page structure visually understandable through predictable sizing, spacing, and box behavior.
outcomes: Explain and manipulate content, padding, border, and margin on the inherited portfolio.
Use spacing and borders to improve grouping without rebuilding HTML.
Use border-box, width, max-width, and image constraints to make sizing predictable.
Use display and overflow to improve existing navigation, tables, forms, and images.
why: Builds confidence with the box model and spacing.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-module-3-flexbox-layout.title: Flexbox Layout
css-module-3-flexbox-layout.description: Build one-dimensional layouts that align, distribute, and wrap content cleanly.
outcomes: Create Flexbox containers from existing semantic portfolio regions.
Reason about main and cross axes from flex-direction.
Align and distribute items with justify-content, align-items, and gap.
Use wrapping and flexible bases for navigation and content cards.
why: Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-module-4-grid-responsive-design.title: Grid and Responsive Design
css-module-4-grid-responsive-design.description: Build two-dimensional layouts that adapt across viewport sizes without device-specific hacks.
outcomes: Create CSS Grid layouts with columns, rows, gap, and repeat().
Use relative units, fr, and minmax() for fluid sizing.
Apply mobile-first media queries for responsive changes.
why: Builds confidence with grid and responsive design.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-module-5-polish-reuse-accessibility.title: Polish, Reuse, and Accessible Styling
css-module-5-polish-reuse-accessibility.description: Turn one-off styling into a small, consistent, maintainable visual system with accessible states.
outcomes: Use custom properties for reusable design values.
Create reusable classes and organize stylesheet sections clearly.
Style hover and keyboard-focus states with readable contrast.
why: Builds confidence with polish, reuse, and accessible styling.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-module-6-final-capstone.title: Final Capstone: Build a Responsive Event Website
css-module-6-final-capstone.description: Transfer the CSS skills from the cumulative learning portfolio to a fresh multi-page project with unfamiliar content and layout requirements.
outcomes: Apply one consistent stylesheet across a multi-page semantic website.
Combine cascade, typography, box model, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, and reusable CSS appropriately.
Preserve semantic HTML while improving the presentation layer.
Review accessible interaction states and responsive behavior before submission.
why: Builds confidence with final capstone: build a responsive event website.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

css-css-module-1-lessons.title: First Styles and the Cascade
css-css-module-1-lessons.description: Learn connecting css to html, selectors, declarations, and rules, color, backgrounds, and typography through focused examples and practice.

css-css-module-2-lessons.title: The Box Model and Spacing
css-css-module-2-lessons.description: Learn the css box model, margin, padding, and borders, sizing and box-sizing through focused examples and practice.

css-css-module-3-lessons.title: Flexbox Layout
css-css-module-3-lessons.description: Learn flex containers and axes, alignment, distribution, and gap, wrapping, sizing, and flex patterns through focused examples and practice.

css-css-module-4-lessons.title: Grid and Responsive Design
css-css-module-4-lessons.description: Learn grid columns and rows, grid placement, gap, and repeat(), responsive units, minmax(), and fluid tracks through focused examples and practice.
bullets: Responsive Units, minmax(), and Fluid Tracks

css-css-module-5-lessons.title: Polish, Reuse, and Accessible Styling
css-css-module-5-lessons.description: Learn custom properties and reusable values, reusable classes and maintainable css, hover, focus, and accessible states through focused examples and practice.

css-css-module-6-capstone.title: Final Capstone
css-css-module-6-capstone.description: Learn build a responsive community tech festival website through focused examples and practice.
bullets: Build a Responsive Community Tech Festival Website
